## Placental Cell Proportions- Summary Forest Plot

This code will combine all of the results from each outcome/model type to create a comprehensive forest plot that allows for comparison across groups.

### Load Packages
```{r load packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
```

### Load Data
```{r load data}
BWadj <- read.csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Results/PlacentalEfficiency/BWadj_N166_CombinedResults_020926.csv")
BWPW <- read.csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Results/PlacentalEfficiency/BWPW_N166_CombinedResults_020926.csv")
BWZ <- read.csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Results/BW_ZScore/BirthweightZ_CombinedResults_N1009_020926.csv")
GestAge <-read.csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Results/GestationalAge/GestationalAge_CombinedResults_N1009_020926.csv")
sPTB <- read.csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Results/sPTB/sPTB_N635_CombinedResults_020926.csv")
```

### Combine Data
```{r combine data}
#Add a column for each outcome
BWadj$Outcome <- c("BWadj N=166")
BWPW$Outcome <- c("BW:PW N=166")
BWZ$Outcome <- c("BW Z-Score N=1009")
GestAge$Outcome <- c("Gestational Age N=1009")
sPTB$Outcome <- c("sPTB N=635")

#Combine into one dataframe
AllData <- rbind(BWadj, BWPW, BWZ, GestAge, sPTB)

#Fix some formatting issues
AllData$CellType <- gsub("Gzmb", "GzmB+", AllData$CellType)
AllData$CellType <- gsub("Gzmk", "GzmK+", AllData$CellType)
AllData$CellType <- gsub("Cd4", "CD4+", AllData$CellType)
AllData$CellType <- gsub("Cd8", "CD8+", AllData$CellType)
AllData$CellType <- gsub("Cd14", "CD14+", AllData$CellType)
AllData$CellType <- gsub("Fcgr3a", "FCGR3A", AllData$CellType)
AllData$CellType <- gsub("T Cells", "T-cells", AllData$CellType)
AllData$CellType <- gsub("B Cells", "B-cells", AllData$CellType)
#Make subtypes to sort the cell types by: 
print(unique(AllData$CellType))
AllData <- AllData %>%
  mutate(
    CellCategory = recode(CellType,
      "Fetal Syncytiotrophoblast"      = "Trophoblast",
      "Fetal Cytotrophoblasts"          = "Trophoblast",
      "Fetal Extravillous Trophoblasts" = "Trophoblast",
      "Fetal Hofbauer Cells"                 = "Fetal Immune",
      "Fetal Endothelial Cells"              = "Fetal Other",
      "Fetal Fibroblasts"                  = "Fetal Other",
      "Fetal Nucleated Red Blood Cells"                  = "Fetal Other",
      "Fetal Natural Killer GzmB+ GzmK+"                  = "Fetal Immune",
      "Fetal Naive CD8+ T-cells"                 = "Fetal Immune", 
      
    "Fetal Memory CD4+ T-cells" = "Fetal Immune", 
    "Fetal CD14+ Monocytes" = "Fetal Immune", 
    "Maternal Naive CD8+ T-cells" = "Maternal Immune", 
    "Maternal FCGR3A Monocytes" = "Maternal Immune", 
    "Maternal CD8+ Activated T-cells" = "Maternal Immune", 
    "Maternal B-cells" = "Maternal Immune"
    )
  )

AllData <- AllData %>%
  mutate(OrderVar = as.numeric(factor(CellCategory)))

#Make the Categories appear in a specific order
AllData <- AllData %>%
  mutate(
    CategoryOrder = recode(CellCategory,
      "Trophoblast" = 3,
      "Fetal Other"    = 4,
      "Fetal Immune"     = 2,  
      "Maternal Immune"      = 1), 
)
#Order cell types
AllData$CellType <- reorder(AllData$CellType, AllData$CategoryOrder)

#Remove dirichlet results since we arne't going to include those
AllData <- AllData %>%
  dplyr::filter(RegressionType != "Dirichlet Regression")

#Sort the Regression Types so that Bootstrap is first then Beta Regression last

AllData <- AllData %>%
  mutate(
    RegressionType = factor(RegressionType, 
                            levels = c("Bootstrap Composition", 
                                       "Beta Regression"),
                            #Names to display on the plot
                            labels = c("Bootstrap Composition", 
                                       "Beta Regression"))
  )
```

### Forest Plot
```{r forest plot}

#All Together
  ggplot(AllData, aes(x =Estimate, y = CellType, color = RegressionType)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = CI_Low, xmax =CI_High),
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), height = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~Outcome, scales = "free_x", nrow=1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Percent Change and 95% Confidence Interval", color = "Estimate Type") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, col="black", linetype="dashed") + 
  theme(
  panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "lines")
) +
  ylab("")

```
